title: Chasing Void/Quotes
summary:
"Do you always pick fights with strangers, or are we special?"
- Dante Vale to Lucas Casterwill

"Events have been set in motion that spell the undoing of the world."
- Lucas Casterwill to the Huntik team

"The kid is honest enough, but I'm not sure we can trust that Zhalia woman."
- Lane about Zhalia Moon and Lok Lambert

"You were too harsh."
- Dellix to Lucas Casterwill about Sophie Casterwill

"Don't be so naïve. Evil is for the storybooks, my boy."
- Wilder to Lok Lambert

"I never wanted this life for you. I wanted my only sister to be safe and happy."
- Lucas Casterwill to Sophie Casterwill

"The Professor that I remember didn't need lies to control anyone. The man had absolute power."
- Hoffman to Stack about the Professor, (Chasing Void)
